title: Site sketch of possible UFO investigation area, Arlington, Virginia, 1-2 Sept 1952
description: Restricted site sketch titled "Sketch of Area: Investigation of Possible Unidentified Flying Object - Arlington, Virginia - 1-2 Sept. 1952". It shows a large circle about 16 ft across with a 6-inch-wide ring, points marked A and B, a square clothes-line frame at left ("Clothes lines on square frame & central pole") and an "Antenna Wire about 40' above ground" crossing at right. A numbered note identifies a "Small evergreen bush 53" high" inside the circle; the sheet is marked "Incl 2".
